assignment.allocation: Externally generated seed; eight labels of each condition; assignment recorded before packet access.
assignment.failed_or_timed_out_sessions: Retained in the fixed denominator and assigned zero exact-success credit.

conditions.description: Git-style history, claims, dependency, source, and evidence documents.
The same atomic facts organized as a Vela-style correction, replay, and why projection.

environment.model_or_participant_policy: Freeze one participant class and, for models, one exact provider/model/reasoning/tool configuration before assignment.
environment.tools: Local packet reads only; no network, Vela authority, source mutation, or hidden predecessor context.

does_not_establish: a Vela Decision or Standing change
external validation, adoption, or general productivity
that the existing synthetic correction-impact reducer models all scientific dependencies

hypothesis: The Vela-organized presentation lowers cold-successor continuation and reassessment cost relative to an information-matched Git-and-documents presentation.

information_matching.protected_material: Scorer adjudication classifications and action-term rules are absent from both condition packets until the frozen capture manifest exists.
information_matching.rule: Every substantive case fact and every source/evidence byte is present in both conditions; only organization, derived navigation metadata, and read affordances differ.

outcomes.cost: Restricted mean wall time with every wrong, invalid, failed, or timed-out session assigned the 600-second cap.
outcomes.interpretation: Passing is a bounded descriptive signal for this synthetic packet. Failure or an incomplete denominator does not support lower continuation cost. No aggregate scientific or adoption claim is permitted.
outcomes.positive_gate: Both arms contain exactly eight sessions; Vela exact successes are at least six and no fewer than Git/documents; Vela has zero authority errors; and Vela restricted mean cost is at most 0.80 of Git/documents.
outcomes.primary: Exact continuation success: exact correction pair, all four classifications, all four first-safe actions, no Standing error, and one exact source/evidence digest.

scoring_freeze.adjudication_access: Only after all 16 responses, run records, packet roots, durations, and tool counts are frozen into capture-manifest.json.
scoring_freeze.amendments: Any post-output change to facts, packets, task, scoring, denominator, timeout, or gate invalidates confirmatory credit and must retain the previous registration root.
